title: Comparison of accelerated corneal collagen cross-linking under normal and increased oxygen concentrations: A pilot study

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 License)

groups.description: Group 1 (Cases), randomized: accelerated epithelium-off CXL (alcohol-assisted debridement, 0.1% iso-osmolar riboflavin-dextran, 9 mW for 10 minutes continuous, 5.4 J/cm2, PXL Platinum 330; Table 1 of the XML, IJO.IJO_1965_25-T1) with local oxygen supplementation through a goggle apparatus at 5 L/min, the investigational arm; progressive keratoconus; inclusion required age older than 18 years.
Group 2 (Controls), randomized: the same accelerated epithelium-off CXL protocol under room-air oxygen; progressive keratoconus; inclusion required age older than 18 years.

series.baseline_label: Steepest Keratometry (Kmax in Diopters), Group 1 (Cases) Baseline column, table IJO.IJO_1965_25-T3
series.notes: mean±SD as printed (Statistical analysis: normally distributed data as mean ± SD); Oculus Pentacam; n = 10 eyes at baseline (Abstract, Results); per-visit n not reported.

series.baseline_label: Steepest Keratometry (Kmax in Diopters), Group 2 (Controls) Baseline column, table IJO.IJO_1965_25-T3
series.notes: mean±SD as printed (Statistical analysis: normally distributed data as mean ± SD); Oculus Pentacam; n = 10 eyes at baseline (Abstract, Results); per-visit n not reported.

exclusions.what: P columns of the Kmax row (IJO.IJO_1965_25-T3!R6C7, R6C13, R6C15, R6C17)
exclusions.reason: p-values are not admissible values (protocol inclusion 4)

exclusions.what: Flat K (K1) and Steep K (K2) rows of IJO.IJO_1965_25-T3
exclusions.reason: K1 and K2 are not Kmax (protocol inclusion 1)
Kmax is tabulated only at baseline and 6 months; earlier visits appear only in figures of other parameters

notes: Table numbering in the XML differs from the in-text references: the cross-linking method is table-wrap IJO.IJO_1965_25-T1, visual and refractive outcomes IJO.IJO_1965_25-T2 (median and IQR), tomography and biomechanics IJO.IJO_1965_25-T3; the 'median (inter-quartile range)' footnote attached to T1 refers to the visual-outcome variables it names, while the Kmax cells of T3 are printed as mean±SD.

Other tabulated parameters (UDVA, CDVA, MRSE in T2; corneal astigmatism, densitometry, posterior elevation, thinnest pachymetry, integrated radius and stress-strain index in T3) and endothelial cell density in the text are not used.
